symptom: PC-1 in Finance Dept cannot ping Server-1 on Switch-2. Local link is UP.
topology_note: PC-1 (Fa0/5) -> Switch-1 (Fa0/24) -> Switch-2 (Fa0/10) -> Server-1. Target VLAN is 10.
show_outputs:
Switch-1# show vlan brief
1 default active Fa0/3, Fa0/4, Fa0/5, Fa0/6
10 Finance active Fa0/1, Fa0/2
Switch-1# show interfaces fa0/5 switchport
Access Mode VLAN: 1 (default)
expected_fault: Access port Fa0/5 on Switch-1 is incorrectly assigned to VLAN 1 instead of VLAN 10.

symptom: PC-A (VLAN 20) on Switch-1 cannot reach PC-B (VLAN 20) on Switch-2 across trunk link.
topology_note: Switch-1 (Gi0/1) connected to Switch-2 (Gi0/1) via 802.1Q trunk.
show_outputs:
Switch-1# show interfaces trunk
Port Mode Encapsulation Status Native vlan
Gi0/1 on 802.1q trunking 1
Port Vlans allowed on trunk
Gi0/1 1-10
Switch-1# show vlan brief
20 Sales active Fa0/1
expected_fault: VLAN 20 is missing from the allowed VLAN list on inter-switch trunk interface Gig0/1.

symptom: Host PC-102 (192.168.1.15/24) can ping local LAN hosts but cannot reach remote server 10.0.0.50.
show_outputs:
C:\> ipconfig /all

symptom: User can ping internal server IP 10.1.1.50
topology_note: but browser fails to load http://app.corp.local with DNS timeout.
show_outputs: Client PC -> Switch -> Router -> Core Services (DNS Server IP: 10.1.1.53).
expected_fault:
C:\> ping 10.1.1.50

DNS request timed out.
Default Server: UnKnown
Address: 192.168.1.250

symptom: Branch Router R2 cannot reach HQ subnet 10.10.0.0/16. Traceroute drops at R2.
topology_note: Branch R2 (192.168.20.0/24) connected to HQ R1 via Serial 0/1/0 (10.0.0.0/30). OSPF routing enabled.
show_outputs:
R2# show ip route
Codes: C - connected, S - static, O - OSPF
Gateway of last resort is not set
C 192.168.20.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0
C 10.0.0.0/30 is directly connected, Serial0/1/0
R2# show ip ospf neighbor
(blank output)
expected_fault: OSPF neighbor adjacency between R1 and R2 is down due to missing network statement or area mismatch on R2.

symptom: HR users in subnet 192.168.10.0/24 can ping Payroll Server 10.0.5.20
topology_note: but HTTP web access (port 80) is denied.
show_outputs: HR Subnet (192.168.10.0/24) -> Router R1 (Gig0/0/1 outbound) -> Payroll Subnet (10.0.5.0/24).
expected_fault:
R1# show access-lists 101
Extended IP access list 101
 10 deny tcp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.5.20 eq www (156 matches)
 20 permit ip any any (450 matches)
R1# show ip interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 Outbound access list is 101
osi_layer: Outbound ACL 101 on interface Gig0/0/1 explicitly denies TCP port 80 (HTTP) traffic from HR subnet to Payroll server.
